open Filter Set TopologicalSpace

theorem Munkres_exercise_30_13 {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
  (h : ∃ (s : Set X), Countable s ∧ Dense s) (U : Set (Set X))
  (hU : ∀ (x y : Set X), x ∈ U → y ∈ U → x ≠ y → x ∩ y = ∅)
  (hUopen : ∀ (u : Set X), u ∈ U → IsOpen u) :
  Countable U := by
  obtain ⟨D, hD_count, hD_dense⟩ := h
  haveI : Countable ↥D := Set.countable_coe_iff.mpr hD_count
  let V : Set (Set X) := {u | u ∈ U ∧ u.Nonempty}
  have hex : ∀ u : ↥V, ∃ x : ↥D, (x : X) ∈ (u : Set X) := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨x, hxu, hxD⟩ :=
      dense_iff_inter_open.mp hD_dense u.1 (hUopen u.1 u.2.1) u.2.2
    exact ⟨⟨x, hxD⟩, hxu⟩
  choose f hf using hex
  have finj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro u v heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    by_contra hne
    have hempty : (u : Set X) ∩ v = ∅ := hU u.1 v.1 u.2.1 v.2.1 hne
    have hnempty : ((u : Set X) ∩ v).Nonempty := ⟨(f u : X), hf u, heq ▸ hf v⟩
    exact hnempty.ne_empty hempty
  have hVc : Countable ↥V := by
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_injective_nat ↥D
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact g ∘ f
    · exact hg.comp finj
  have hsub : U ⊆ insert ∅ V := by
    intro u hu
    by_cases hne : u.Nonempty
    · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ ⟨hu, hne⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne)
  have hUc : Set.Countable U :=
    Set.Countable.mono hsub ((Set.countable_coe_iff.mp hVc).insert ∅)
  exact Set.countable_coe_iff.mpr hUc

import Mathlib
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Munkres_exercise_30_13 {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
  (h : ∃ (s : Set X), Countable s ∧ Dense s) (U : Set (Set X))
  (hU : ∀ (x y : Set X), x ∈ U → y ∈ U → x ≠ y → x ∩ y = ∅)
  (hUopen : ∀ (u : Set X), u ∈ U → IsOpen u) :
  Countable U := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsd⟩ := h
  
  let f : U → Option s := fun u =>
    if hu : (u : Set X).Nonempty then
      let q := hsd.exists_mem_open (hUopen u u.property) hu
      some ⟨q.choose, q.choose_spec.1⟩
    else
      none
  
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b hab
    by_contra hne
    by_cases ha : (a : Set X).Nonempty
    · let qa := hsd.exists_mem_open (hUopen a a.property) ha
      have hfa : f a = some ⟨qa.choose, qa.choose_spec.1⟩ := by
        simp [f, ha]
  
      have hb : (b : Set X).Nonempty := by
        by_contra hb'
        have hfb : f b = none := by
          simp [f, hb']
        rw [hfa, hfb] at hab
        simp at hab
  
      let qb := hsd.exists_mem_open (hUopen b b.property) hb
      have hfb : f b = some ⟨qb.choose, qb.choose_spec.1⟩ := by
        simp [f, hb]
  
      have heq : qa.choose = qb.choose := by
        have hh := hab
        rw [hfa, hfb] at hh
        injection hh with hh'
        exact congrArg Subtype.val hh'
  
      have hne' : (a : Set X) ≠ (b : Set X) := by
        intro hab'
        exact hne (Subtype.ext hab')
  
      have hmemA : qa.choose ∈ (a : Set X) :=
        qa.choose_spec.2
      have hmemB : qb.choose ∈ (b : Set X) :=
        qb.choose_spec.2
      have hdis := hU a b a.property b.property hne'
  
      have hempty : qa.choose ∈ (∅ : Set X) := by
        rw [← hdis]
        exact ⟨hmemA, heq ▸ hmemB⟩
  
      exact hempty.elim
    · have haempty : (a : Set X) = ∅ :=
        Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp ha
  
      have hb : ¬ (b : Set X).Nonempty := by
        intro hb'
        let qb := hsd.exists_mem_open (hUopen b b.property) hb'
        have hfb : f b = some ⟨qb.choose, qb.choose_spec.1⟩ := by
          simp [f, hb']
        have hfa : f a = none := by
          simp [f, ha]
        rw [hfa, hfb] at hab
        simp at hab
  
      have hbempty : (b : Set X) = ∅ :=
        Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hb
      exact hne (Subtype.ext (haempty.trans hbempty.symm))
  
  exact hf.countable

import Mathlib
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Munkres_exercise_30_13 {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
  (h : ∃ (s : Set X), Countable s ∧ Dense s) (U : Set (Set X))
  (hU : ∀ (x y : Set X), x ∈ U → y ∈ U → x ≠ y → x ∩ y = ∅)
  (hUopen : ∀ (u : Set X), u ∈ U → IsOpen u) :
  Countable U := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hsCountable, hsDense⟩ := h
  
  have hMem :
      ∀ {u : Set X}, u ∈ U → Set.Nonempty u →
        ∃ x ∈ s, x ∈ u := by
    intro u hu hnonempty
    obtain ⟨x, hxs, hxu⟩ :=
      hsDense.exists_mem_open (hUopen u hu) hnonempty
    exact ⟨x, hxs, hxu⟩
  
  have hMemSubtype :
      ∀ u : {u : Set X // u ∈ U ∧ Set.Nonempty u},
        ∃ x : {x : X // x ∈ s}, (x : X) ∈ (u : Set X) := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨x, hxs, hxu⟩ :=
      hMem u.property.1 u.property.2
    exact ⟨⟨x, hxs⟩, hxu⟩
  
  choose pick hpick using hMemSubtype
  
  have hpick_inj : Function.Injective pick := by
    intro u v huv
    have huMem : ((pick u : X)) ∈ (u : Set X) := hpick u
    have hvMem : ((pick u : X)) ∈ (v : Set X) := by
      simpa [huv] using hpick v
    have hEqSets : (u : Set X) = (v : Set X) := by
      by_contra hne
      have hdisj :=
        hU (u : Set X) (v : Set X) u.property.1 v.property.1 hne
      have hz : (pick u : X) ∈ (u : Set X) ∩ (v : Set X) :=
        ⟨huMem, hvMem⟩
      rw [hdisj] at hz
      exact hz
    exact Subtype.ext hEqSets
  
  letI : Countable s := hsCountable
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Countable.exists_injective_nat (α := s)
  
  have hcountSubtype :
      Countable {u : Set X // u ∈ U ∧ Set.Nonempty u} := by
    refine ⟨⟨fun u => g (pick u), ?_⟩⟩
    exact hg.comp hpick_inj
  
  let nonemptyMembers : Set (Set X) :=
    {u | u ∈ U ∧ Set.Nonempty u}
  
  have hcountNonemptyMembers : nonemptyMembers.Countable := by
    have hsub : Countable ↥nonemptyMembers := by
      simpa [nonemptyMembers] using hcountSubtype
    exact Countable.to_set hsub
  
  let emptySingleton : Set (Set X) := ({∅} : Set (Set X))
  
  have hSingleton : emptySingleton.Countable := by
    simp [emptySingleton]
  
  have hcountUnion : (emptySingleton ∪ nonemptyMembers).Countable :=
    hSingleton.union hcountNonemptyMembers
  
  have hUsubset : U ⊆ emptySingleton ∪ nonemptyMembers := by
    intro u hu
    by_cases hne : Set.Nonempty u
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hu, hne⟩
    · have huempty : u = (∅ : Set X) := by
        simpa [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] using hne
      exact Or.inl (by simp [emptySingleton, huempty])
  
  exact hcountUnion.mono hUsubset
